counting_gate: This is a design verdict from an adversarial Opus debate (workflow wtrl34wzh), NOT an executed run. Docs != progress. C8 credit requires the probe to RUN on the 4090 via the train daemon and emit the measured receipt with all four conditions passing (or an honest NEGATIVE that refutes IVF-PQ-as-replacement and escalates per kill_criterion).
objective_frame: TRUE SOVEREIGN COMPUTING: train+quantize+run recursive loops indefinitely on one private RTX 4090; the all-pairs softmax(QK^T/sqrt d)V is O(t)/step -> grows with lifetime -> incompatible with indefinite sovereign recursion on fixed hardware -> must be REPLACED (not bounded) by content-addressable sub-linear retrieval that preserves lossless associative recall. Eval = recursive-loop cost curve (cost vs accumulated history t), NOT a single forward pass.
verdict: CONDITIONAL. Replaceable by sub-linear-in-t content retrieval ONLY IF four conditions jointly hold UNDER MEASUREMENT (not assumption): (C1) live per-step cost INCLUDING index insertion fits log-log slope <=0.2 in t AND insert-term slope <1.0; (C2) MASS-recall@k (fraction of top-p softmax mass captured, NOT id-recall) >=0.98 as t->3e5+; (C3) survives EMBEDDING DRIFT (stored keys re-embedded by a later checkpoint, re-queried in the drifted space); (C4) L2/cosine index metric tracks softmax relevance, metric-mismatch gap <2%. Any one fails => retrieval is refuted as recall-lossy (=banned substrate-downgrade) OR O(t)-maintenance (=wall relocated, not broken).
chosen_mechanism: Owned IVF-PQ content-addressable KV memory + bounded recent-window cascade (single owned torch/CUDA module; NOT FAISS-as-dependency, NOT HNSW). Recent W=2048 tokens: exact O(1)-in-t windowed dot-product. Older keys: appended to IVF-PQ index (coarse Voronoi quantizer nlist~sqrt(t), 2-level above t=1e5, lazy recluster on geometric t-doubling for O(1)-amortized insert; PQ m=8 subquantizers, LUT scan), query top-k=256, then bounded dot-product attends ONLY over {window + retrieved}. Preserves lossless content-addressable recall within the retrieved set (NOT a lossy fixed-state downgrade).
design_knob_call: BOUNDED-WINDOW + SUB-LINEAR RETRIEVAL (reject pure-retrieval). (a) recent tokens carry highest softmax mass and are most volatile/un-indexed -> exact window catches them deterministically; (b) the window is the drift firewall while the encoder trains. Probe includes a pure-retrieval arm (W=0) to MEASURE this dominance, not assume it.

configs.A: FULL-SDPA over all t keys (FlashAttention kernel; recall+cost oracle/baseline, the BEST honest O(t))
configs.B: IVF-PQ retrieval + bounded window W=2048 (the candidate)
configs.D: B with a FROZEN index, no per-step insert (isolates the insertion tax; B-minus-D gap = the tax)

metrics.primary: recursive-loop cost curve: median per-step wall-time as t grows over {1e3,4e3,1.6e4,6.4e4,2.56e5,1e6}, 1000 recursive steps each, INCLUDING live insertion; fit log-log slope. PASS if B slope<=0.2 AND insert-term slope<1.0. Report p99 per-step too (recluster spike / tail-latency check).
metrics.secondary: mass-recall@256 = fraction of top-p(=0.99) softmax mass captured by retrieved set, measured (i) frozen embeddings and (ii) after re-embedding all stored keys with a +5k-step checkpoint and re-querying (drift leg).
metrics.tertiary: metric-mismatch gap = mass-recall when top-softmax key != top-cosine neighbor.
metrics.recall_tasks: (1) associative-recall, (2) exact-copy of an early span, (3) needle-in-haystack; measured at EVERY t-checkpoint, never once.
metrics.context: d=64, fp16, <=0.80 VRAM. NOT single-pass speedup, NOT memory-fit. Log the checkpoint's attention-entropy alongside recall (under-trained-model artifact guard).

pass_threshold: needle_acc and copy_acc >= 0.98 of A ground truth, AND mass-recall@256 >= 0.99 frozen at every t incl 1e6, AND >= 0.95 mass-recall post-drift. eps=0.02 accuracy / 0.01 mass.
kill_criterion: KILL IVF-PQ-as-replacement if at t=1e6: mass-recall@256 <0.95 frozen OR <0.90 post-drift OR per-step log-log slope >=0.9 (incl insertion) OR insert-term slope >=1.0 OR no cost crossover with full-SDPA by t=6.4e4 OR metric-mismatch gap >2%. KILL is of the MECHANISM, not the retrieval direction: escalate to 2-level/learned-residual index or softmax-metric-aligned quantizer. NEVER revert to a lossy O(n) state substrate (Mamba) and NEVER conclude 'Ember consolidates to weights so it needs no long history'. Only the user abandons retrieval as the direction.
negative_signatures: B log-log slope >=0.9 OR insert-term slope ~1.0 once insertion in the clock => cost still grows with t (wall relocated to index maintenance).
mass-recall@256 degrades monotonically with t or collapses <0.95 under drift => recall-LOSSY = banned substrate-downgrade in disguise.
metric-mismatch gap >2% => index optimizes cosine vs softmax relevance, recall-biased even with perfect ANN.
open_risks: d=64 bounded-poly crossover cited upstream has NO receipt in this tree (grep empty) -> A re-derives the O(t) baseline from scratch, do not cite the survey prose as evidence.
INSERTION TAX likeliest silent failure: lazy-recluster amortization bursts on each t-doubling -> report p99 per-step not just median, or amortization hides a halt-on-recluster.
EMBEDDING DRIFT deepest + least de-riskable in synthetic probe: +5k-step drift leg is a proxy; real co-training drift could be faster/structured.
METRIC MISMATCH may be the true ceiling: if gap systematically >2%, needs a maxip/softmax-aware quantizer (larger build than this probe scopes).

Mass concentration (>99% top-k) is empirical for TRAINED attention; Ember is pretraining-stage so early attention is near-uniform -> low recall may be an under-trained-model artifact, hence log attention-entropy.
gpu_hours_estimate: ~1.5-2.5 GPU-h on the 4090. Dominated by t=1e6 full-SDPA arm A; cap A at t<=2.56e5 and EXTRAPOLATE its linear slope to 1M if wall-time exceeds budget. Retrieval arms are minutes. Drift re-embed leg ~20 GPU-min. One governed daemon session, <=0.80 VRAM.
